title: Repeated radius-loss derivative budget obstruction for the Q3 history candidate
question: Can the formal bi-entire radius-loss derivative estimates supply a volume-independent C^n bound for arbitrarily long Q3 histories at a fixed positive radius?
method: Reconstruct the registered actual Q3 source polynomial P and recompute its two-orientation weighted coefficient rate B=1382807/7168 at (R_q,R_v,S)=(4,8,1/4).
Use the exact coefficient-space witness f_n(a)=a^n: its source norm is S^n and its n-fold source derivative is n!, independently of the final reduced radius.
Check the exact lower-bound ratios n!/S^n for orders 1,2,4,8,16,32 and compare them with the six-neighbour/two-orientation branch base 12.
Verify the elementary even-order factorial lower bound and compile Lean R289 for the rational radius and order-8/order-32 fixtures.
Apply adversarial review to the derivative-versus-history distinction, radius-loss scope, volume/orientation counting, operator promotion, and QFT boundaries.
finding: The actual Q3 source polynomial remains a formal weighted coefficient object with source degree four and equal center/reverse rate B=1382807/7168. For the formal source derivative D_a, f_n(a)=a^n gives ||D_a^n|| >= n!/S^n for every final radius S'>0. At S=1/4, the exact order-8 ratio already exceeds 12^8, and the even-order bound n! >= (n/2)^(n/2) proves superexponential growth relative to every fixed C. Radius loss therefore does not rescue the pure repeated-derivative envelope.
decision_reason: EXP-001116 supplied only a one-step radius-loss multiplier and conditional recurrence. This package shows that iterating the corresponding pure derivative estimate cannot by itself furnish the required exponential history bound. The result parks that topology and selects a derivative-closed cancellation, non-Leibniz analytic/Frechet, symmetric or state-weighted construction as the next admissible route.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing route boundary. The pure repeated radius-loss derivative architecture is rejected for the formal coefficient model; this is not a no-go theorem for the actual Q3 representation or for alternative common-core/state-weighted topologies.

adversarial_review.check: Radii, source degree and B are derived from the registered Q3 source manifests.
Only the pure D_a^n coefficient model is obstructed; cancellations and actual Q3 commutator incidence remain open.
The n-fold derivative witness is constant after differentiation, so reducing the output radius cannot improve the lower bound.
Order-8 and order-32 rows are finite diagnostics; the general conclusion uses the displayed factorial lower bound.
No dynamics, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure follows.
R289 checks rational fixtures only and does not encode unbounded domains or limits.

qft_interface.closed: The radius-loss derivative candidate fails its own repeated-history exponential test in the formal coefficient model.
